title: Delivery experience and power delivery
summary: This topic combines dealership delivery experiences with unrelated comments about drivetrain power delivery, so the sample does not form a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise a smooth and helpful sales or handover process and also compliment strong, responsive power delivery.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention an awful delivery delay and a case of vehicle damage identified at delivery, with limited examples overall.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly reference timing after taking delivery or the sales and delivery side without enough detail to judge sentiment toward delivery itself.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes at least two distinct subjects: dealership delivery experience and vehicle power delivery.
Many fragments use 'after taking delivery' only as a time marker, so they do not clearly express sentiment about delivery.
Examples are limited for the negative theme beyond delay and delivery-related damage.
